gates.name: reference-agreement:fuzzy_vs_neurokit
gates.detail: 6/6 agree [fuzzyen_m2=0.94755 vs ref 0.94755; fuzzyen_m3=0.70391 vs ref 0.70391; max_diff_nk=3.5527e-15 vs ref 0; sampen_m2=1.3272 vs ref 1.3272; fuzzy_vs_sampen_gap=0.37968 vs ref 0.37968; monotonic=1 vs ref 1]
gates.citation: Chen W, Zhuang J, Yu W, Wang Z (2009). Measuring complexity using FuzzyEn, ApEn, and SampEn. Med Eng Phys 31(1):61-68. Reference impl: NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy / entropy_sample (Makowski et al. 2021). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Chen W, Zhuang J, Yu W, Wang Z (2009). Measuring complexity using FuzzyEn, ApEn, and SampEn. Med Eng Phys 31(1):61-68. Reference impl: NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy / entropy_sample (Makowski et al. 2021). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the fuzzy entropy with NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy across (dimension, r) and contrasts it with the crisp sample entropy (NeuroKit2 entropy_sample) at m=2, r=0.2; reports FuzzyEn at m=2 and m=3, the bit-exact NeuroKit2 agreement, the SampEn reference, the fuzzy-vs-sample gap, and the monotonicity
